text: At its meeting on July 11, 2022, the Nominating Panel -Toronto Local Appeal Body considered Item XV8.1, Appointment of Public Members to the Toronto Local Appeal Body and made recommendations to City Council.

City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Local Appeal Body for a term of office ending July 16, 2026, and until successors are appointed: Ron Kanter Trevor Kezwer Blair Martin Paula Turtle 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 6 to the report (June 27, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body. Confidential Attachments 1 to 6 to the report (June 27, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.
